name: Nauders Dreiländereck
kurzbeschreibung: The Tripoint near Nauders on the Reschen Pass unites the borders of Austria, Italy, and Switzerland into a scenic alpine crossroads steeped in history and sweeping views.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Tripoint near Nauders (Dreiländereck) atop the historic Reschen Pass marks a geographically unique and culturally resonant crossroads in the Alps: here, the borders of Austria (Tirol), Italy (South Tyrol), and Switzerland (Graubünden) converge seamlessly. Situated at an altitude of 2,179 metres above Nauders, a distinctive tripartite border monument commemorates the enduring friendship between three European nations. Framed by the colossal peaks of the Ötztal Alps, the Sesvenna range, and the Samnaun Alps, this scenic plateau commands magnificent vistas extending across the Engadine, the Vinschgau valley, and the Upper Inn Valley. Beyond its historical symbolism, the region delights outdoor enthusiasts with rolling alpine pastures, blooming alpine roses, and century-old fortress history.

Route & Anforderungen

Hiking to the Tripoint border stone is a rewarding alpine outing well suited for families and active nature enthusiasts. A particularly scenic and accessible approach begins at the top terminal of the Bergkastel cable car (2,200 m) in Nauders. From the station, a clearly signposted panoramic trail meanders across undulating alpine meadows and sparse larch groves to reach the border monument in roughly two hours of gentle hiking. Ambitious mountaineers can choose to ascend on foot from Nauders via Norbertshöhe and the idyllic Schwarzsee lakes, or extend their trek to the summit of Piz Lad (2,808 m). Sturdy hiking boots, weather-appropriate gear, and personal identification documents are essential when crossing international boundaries.

Besuch & Anreise

Nauders is conveniently located at 1,394 metres altitude along the Reschen highway (B180) immediately north of the Italian border. Approaching from the Inn Valley, travelers reach Nauders via Landeck and Pfunds by car or by frequent regional buses departing Landeck-Zams railway station. Ample free parking is provided at the base terminal of the Nauders mountain lifts. During the summer hiking season, local shuttles connect Nauders with Lake Reschen and cross-border trailheads.

Tipps

Pair your border hike with a visit to historic Fortress Nauders, the only fully intact military road defense installation of its kind surviving from the Austrian Empire. A short excursion south to Lake Reschen to photograph the iconic submerged church tower of Graun completes an extraordinary day.
preis: Free access (Nauders cable cars optional for a fee)
oeffnungszeiten: Accessible year-round; alpine hiking recommended June to October
